evidence.quote: The Ni20Cr3Al-xCo powder was produced by mechanical alloying. Ni20Cr powder (30–50 μm, Tijo Co., Ltd, China), Al powder (2 μm, Tijo Co., Ltd, China), and Co powder (2 μm, Tijo Co., Ltd, China) were mixed in a planetary ball mill (XQM-4 L, Changsha Ten can Powder, China). 316 stainless steel vials and balls were utilized as the container and grinding media respectively. The ball-to-powder mass ratio was 10:1. Before the mechanical alloying process, the vials with mixed powder inside are evacuated to −0.1 MPa and then filled with argon gas using a glove box. The total ball milling duration was 27 h, with an intermittent operation cycle of 30 min followed by a 15 min pause, and the rotational speed was 300 rpm. To reduce cold welding, 0.5 ml of n-heptane per 100 g of powder was added.
Thereafter, the mixtures were consolidated by cold compaction and then sintered by SPS (HPD250-C, FCT System GmbH, Germany) in vacuum (0.1 Pa) at 1100 °C under pressure of 40 MPa for 15 min.
